scope: Ten-site operator control for the diagonal trace orientation. The row idempotents are genuine projections: their ordinary traces equal the (a,b,b,a) residues and the primary dimensions. The (a,b,a,b) residues equal trace(P e), where P is the path-pair swap. P is not the action of the coefficient unit, so this is not an R-character of e and not the ordinary column-cut trace. The column trace functional is the ordinary trace on the column-cut module; it is not the column rank. At twelve sites the column residues therefore cannot be used as column ranks without a separate column operator check. No twelve-site rank or score change is claimed.
